mag.season.07.issueTitle: 夏窗开张：先救火，再做梦
mag.season.07.issueTitleEn: The Window Opens: Fires First, Dreams Later

pages.headline: 窗户一开，谁先慌？
pages.headlineEn: The Window Opens — Who Panics First?
pages.deck: 夏窗第一周：酒吧在找前锋，保级队在找命。
pages.deckEn: Week one of the summer window: a pub is hunting a striker, a relegation side is hunting survival.
pages.bodyLeft: 转会窗刚开一条缝，黑麦酒馆的求助信就先到了。主力前锋庆祝过头，周末比赛无人可用。应急招聘的规矩只有一条：先看下周能不能踢，再谈以后。
pages.bodyLeftEn: The Rye Tavern wrote first: striker over-celebrated, Saturday unmanned. Rule one: can he play next week?
pages.bodyRight: 另一头，法罗灯塔的保级警报响彻整个夏天。他们的清单不华丽：一个冷静、可靠、见过大风浪的后卫。履历上的豪门名字帮不了他们，丢球数字才可以。
pages.bodyRightEn: Lighthouse Harbour want one calm, storm-proven defender. Big names won't help — goals conceded will.
pages.pullQuote: 夏窗第一课：需求是真的，故事不一定。
pages.pullQuoteEn: Lesson one of the summer window: the need is real. The story might not be.
pages.sidebarBody: 宿醉前锋的替班、保级队的后卫、一位跑得比简历快的荷兰边锋。来源核对一遍，再核对一遍。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: A stand-in for a hungover striker, a defender for a relegation scrap, and a Dutch winger who outruns his own CV. Check the sources. Then check them again.

pages.headline: 应急招聘的三条纪律
pages.headlineEn: Three Rules of Emergency Recruitment
pages.deck: 当俱乐部说“随便来一个”，恰恰是最不能随便的时候。
pages.deckEn: When a club says 'anyone will do' is exactly when anyone won't.
pages.bodyLeft: 每年夏窗第一周，球探的邮箱里都躺着几封语气诚恳的求救信。今年最诚恳的一封来自黑麦酒馆：头号前锋在庆祝一场业余胜利之后，暂时失去了出场能力。这类需求的标准解法是找一位“即插即用”的老熟人，但本刊建议先问三个问题：他上周踢了吗？踢了多久？对手是谁？三个问题答不上来，报价单就先别签。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Week one's earnest SOS came from The Rye Tavern: the star striker celebrated an amateur win into unavailability. Before a plug-and-play signing, ask — did he play last week? How long? Against whom? No answers, no offer.
pages.bodyRight: 法罗灯塔的求助信严肃得多。保级队的防线焦虑写在每一个丢球里，他们要的不是名气，而是一个在禁区里不发抖的人。本刊提醒：“经验丰富”在经纪人词典里约等于“年纪不小”，请把出场记录翻到最近两个赛季，再决定要不要感动。第一周的市场，耐心比钱包重要。
pages.bodyRightEn: Lighthouse Harbour need a man who doesn't tremble in his own box, not a name. 'Vastly experienced' is agent-speak for 'not young' — read two seasons back. Week one: patience beats the wallet.
pages.pullQuote: 应急招聘签的是下周，不是下赛季。
pages.pullQuoteEn: An emergency signing is for next week, not next season.
pages.sidebarBody: 黑麦酒馆：前锋一名，能醒着上场即可。法罗灯塔：后卫一名，要求关键时刻心率正常。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: The Rye Tavern: one striker, must be awake at kick-off. Lighthouse Harbour: one defender, normal heart rate in big moments.

pages.headline: 门德斯：跑得比报价单快的人
pages.headlineEn: Mendes: Faster Than His Own Offer Sheet
pages.deck: 荷甲过人王进入自由市场，速度是真的，别的要再看。
pages.deckEn: The Eredivisie dribble king hits the open market. The pace is real; the rest needs a second look.
pages.bodyLeft: 启动第一步是教科书级别：拿球、沉肩，人已经在一米开外。反击场景里他一个人就是一套战术，长距离带球推进时，回追的后卫看起来像在进行另一种运动。经纪团队提供的集锦与公开录像口径一致，速度一项无需存疑。职业口碑不错，训练出勤稳定。
pages.bodyLeftEn: First step: textbook — receive, drop the shoulder, gone. On the counter, a one-man tactic. Showreel matches public footage; speed beyond doubt. Solid pro, steady attendance.
pages.bodyRight: 传中质量像抽签，同一场比赛能送出妙传，也能送出边线球。身体对抗在强度升级后能否站住，需要更多样本。终结能力目前是“到场”而非“到账”。另外提醒：速度型边锋的简历折旧很快，签他之前，先想清楚你的战术里有没有他的跑道。
pages.bodyRightEn: Crossing is a raffle; durability needs more samples. Finishing is 'on the scene', not 'on the scoresheet'. Pace CVs depreciate fast — does your system have his runway?
pages.pullQuote: 速度能过他，传球未必找得到他。
pages.pullQuoteEn: The pace beats his man. The pass may not find one.
pages.sidebarBody: 基于三季公开录像与两场现场。经纪人集锦已按本刊规矩丢弃。与首期“41球”同理：数字先找出处，再谈感情。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Three seasons of public footage, two live viewings. The agent's showreel was binned per house rules. As with issue one's '41 goals': source the number first, then feel things.

pages.headline: 费雷拉：低级别联赛的防波堤
pages.headlineEn: Ferreira: The Lower-League Breakwater
pages.deck: 没有豪门履历的三十六岁后卫，恰好是保级队要找的那种人？
pages.deckEn: A 36-year-old defender with no big-club CV — exactly what a relegation fighter needs?
pages.bodyLeft: 十八个赛季，全部在低级别联赛，全部踢完。位置感是被上千次传中砸出来的直觉：不扑、不赌、不失位。指挥防线话不多，但每句都在点上。前队友说他“只是比所有人多坚持了十年”——本刊认为这句话本身就是履历。体能管理成熟，训练从不缺席。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Eighteen lower-league seasons, all completed. His positioning never gambles. 'He simply lasted ten years longer,' says a former teammate — and that sentence is the CV.
pages.bodyRight: 年龄写在身份证上，也写在回追的第一步里。面对速度型前锋，他需要整条防线帮他争取半米。没有顶级联赛经验，意味着没有顶级联赛的参照系，“保级队核心”与“低级别老兵”之间，隔着一层没验证过的窗户纸。签约前请务必现场看一场客场雨战。
pages.bodyRightEn: The age is on his ID and in his first recovery step; against pace the line must buy him half a metre. Top level is untested glass. Before signing, watch him away. In the rain.
pages.pullQuote: 他不是天才，他只是没放弃，这更贵。
pages.pullQuoteEn: He isn't a genius. He just never quit. That costs more.
pages.sidebarBody: “经验丰富”请折算成最近两季出场分钟再阅读。保级队来信要求“关键时刻站出来”，他的样本恰好够。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Convert 'experienced' into minutes across the last two seasons before reading on. The club asked for someone who 'steps up in big moments' — his sample is exactly that.

mag.season.08.issueTitle: 金元特别报道：名气的报价单
mag.season.08.issueTitleEn: Money Special: The Price List of Fame

pages.headline: 海湾的支票本又打开了
pages.headlineEn: The Gulf Chequebook Is Open Again
pages.deck: 金色沙丘开出巨额报价，指名要“大家都认识的人”。问题只剩一个：名气怎么验收？
pages.deckEn: Golden Dune's huge bid names one demand: 'someone everyone knows'. One question remains — how do you inspect fame on delivery?
pages.bodyLeft: 金色沙丘的来信只有一行要求加粗：知名度。能力可以谈，年龄可以谈，钱不用谈。这是转会市场上最昂贵、也最容易买错的一类需求。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Golden Dune's bolded demand: fame. Money isn't a topic — the easiest demand to get wrong.
pages.bodyRight: 同一周，一位自称传奇球王远房亲戚的前锋回到了货架上。家谱和支票本同时出现，本刊编辑部闻到了熟悉的味道——和某人的“41球”同一个配方。
pages.bodyRightEn: A legend's self-declared relative is back on the shelf. Family tree plus chequebook — the '41 goals' recipe.
pages.pullQuote: 名气能卖票，但票买不来进球。
pages.pullQuoteEn: Fame sells tickets. Tickets don't score goals.
pages.sidebarBody: 名气三问：认识他的人记得他做什么？最近的高光是哪一年？高光和现在的他有什么关系？
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Three questions for fame: do those who know him remember what he did? Which year was his last highlight? And what has it to do with him now?

pages.headline: 名气汇率：一张脸能换多少分钟
pages.headlineEn: The Fame Exchange Rate: Minutes for a Face
pages.deck: 从球衣销量到出场时间，名气的兑换率每天都在变。
pages.deckEn: From shirt sales to minutes played, fame's exchange rate moves daily.
pages.bodyLeft: 金色沙丘的报价逻辑并不新鲜：买名气，顺便买足球。这类交易的坑在于，名气是折旧极快的资产——它按“最近一次被提起”计价，而不是按“最近一次进球”。签约发布会上球迷欢呼的分贝，与半个赛季后替补席的温度，往往成反比。本刊建议所有想买名气的俱乐部先做一个小测试：把名字遮住，只看最近两个赛季的出场与贡献，再问自己还激动吗。
pages.bodyLeftEn: The logic isn't new: buy the name, get the football free. Fame depreciates fast — priced by 'last mentioned', not 'last scored'; unveiling decibels and bench temperature move inversely. Test: cover the name, read two seasons of minutes. Still excited?
pages.bodyRight: 至于“传奇的亲戚”这个品种，市场早就给出过定价：故事归故事，合同归合同。血缘无法通过体检，天赋也没有遗传证明书。当年“41球”罗里教会我们：凡是需要邻居出面作证的天赋，一律按传闻处理。金色沙丘的钱不是我们的钱，但本刊还是劝一句：支票本打开之前，先把录像打开。
pages.bodyRightEn: The 'legend's relative' was priced long ago. Bloodlines fail medicals; talent needing a neighbour's testimony is folklore — see Rory's '41 goals'. Not our money, but open the footage before the chequebook.
pages.pullQuote: 遮住名字看数据，遮住数据看名字，两遍都要看。
pages.pullQuoteEn: Read the numbers with the name covered; the name with the numbers covered. Do both.
pages.sidebarBody: 名气资产：按热搜计价，按分钟折旧。家谱优势：尚未被任何体测项目收录。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Fame asset: priced by trending topics, depreciates by the minute. Family-tree advantage: not yet recognised by any fitness test.

pages.headline: 罗萨莱斯：家谱比射术厚
pages.headlineEn: Rosales: A Family Tree Thicker Than His Finishing
pages.deck: 故事很动听，邻居很热情，录像很诚实。
pages.deckEn: A lovely story. Enthusiastic neighbours. Honest footage.
pages.bodyLeft: 必须公平地说：青年联赛时期的他确实有过灵气，小范围的触球和想象力带着南美街头的味道。“球王来家里吃过饭”的传闻至少说明，他从小生活在足球氛围里。营销价值也是真实存在——球衣背后印上这个姓氏，确实有人愿意买单。
pages.bodyLeftEn: In youth football he had spark; 'the king dined at their house' proves a football childhood. The marketing is real too — that surname sells shirts.
pages.bodyRight: 问题在于，“亲戚”两个字无法通过任何一项足球测试。成年后的比赛样本稀薄，体能储备在正式强度下能撑多久是未知数，职业态度也只有传闻级别。邻居的证词热情洋溢，但邻居的考核标准不是职业标准。若金色沙丘只为名气而来，请便；若为进球而来，请绕路。
pages.bodyRightEn: 'Relative' passes no football test: the adult sample is thin and neighbours don't grade to pro standards. Wanting fame, Golden Dune? Be our guest. Wanting goals? Take the next turning.
pages.pullQuote: 天赋不遗传，训练量更不遗传。
pages.pullQuoteEn: Talent isn't hereditary. Training volume even less so.
pages.sidebarBody: 自述：家族遗传。佐证：邻居。可核实材料：青年联赛片段若干。本刊评级：按传闻处理。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Self-report: hereditary genius. Corroboration: neighbours. Verifiable: a few youth clips. Our rating: treat as folklore.

pages.headline: 莫拉：叹息之墙，真实存在
pages.headlineEn: Mora: The Wall of Sighs Is Real
pages.deck: 比甲单季零封第一的门将进入市场，这次数字对得上录像。
pages.deckEn: Belgium's clean-sheet leader enters the market. This time the numbers match the tape.
pages.bodyLeft: 近距离反应是顶级的：单刀球面前，他的出击时机像提前读了射门者的念头。一米内的二次扑救尤其罕见，重心丢出去了还能再捞回来。比甲单季零封场次第一，这个口径我们核对过——赛事级别、出场分钟、点球占比都站得住。本刊首期的核对清单，他全过了。
pages.bodyLeftEn: One-v-one, his timing reads the shooter's mind; second saves from a metre out are real. Most clean sheets in the Pro League — the framing verified. Issue one's checklist: passed whole.
pages.bodyRight: 需要提醒的是，零封是整条防线的合影，不是门将的独照。他身前那条防线纪律极佳，换一队人还能不能复制，要看新东家的防守结构。出击范围偏保守，遇到高位逼抢体系时，出球环节会受考验。价格不便宜，但贵和贵得有理，是两回事。
pages.bodyRightEn: A clean sheet is a team photo, not a selfie — the record may not travel. Sweeping conservative; a press will test his feet. Expensive, but fairly expensive.
pages.pullQuote: 零封先问防线，再问门将——他两项都经得起问。
pages.pullQuoteEn: Ask the defence about clean sheets first, then the keeper. He survives both questions.
pages.sidebarBody: 零封第一：已核。样本：完整赛季。参照：格斯“第五次扑点”那年的抽查口径。结论：真实，可买，要带说明书。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Clean-sheet leader: verified. Sample: a full season. Reference: the audit standard of Gus's 'fifth penalty save' year. Verdict: real, buyable — bring the manual.

mag.season.09.issueTitle: 体能特辑：神话也要测心率
mag.season.09.issueTitleEn: Stamina Special: Even Myths Get Heart-Rate Tests

pages.headline: 时速两百公里的坦克进站了
pages.headlineEn: The 200 km/h Tank Pulls In
pages.deck: 一个让边锋让路的翼卫，一个加时赛还在冲刺的前锋：体能神话，先过体测关。
pages.deckEn: A wing-back who makes wingers yield; a striker still sprinting in extra time. Stamina myths must clear the fitness test first.
pages.bodyLeft: “时速200公里的坦克”——这个称号从法国一路开进本刊编辑部。前队友的证词很统一：他训练赛一启动，大家的第一反应是让路。
pages.bodyLeftEn: 'A 200 km/h tank' drove in from France. Teammates agree: when he starts a run, all step aside.
pages.bodyRight: 另一位“永动机”的卖点更朴素：90分钟后还能跑，加时赛还能冲。工业联本周来信说伤了七个人，老板只问一句“他容易受伤吗”。体能，突然成了硬通货。
pages.bodyRightEn: The perpetual motion machine: sprinting in extra time. Rivet United, seven down, ask only 'Is he injury-prone?'
pages.pullQuote: 体能是最诚实的资产，因为装不出来。
pages.pullQuoteEn: Stamina is football's most honest asset: it cannot be faked.
pages.sidebarBody: 绰号不计入体测。“坦克”要看冲刺次数，“永动机”要看高强度跑占比。数字请来自追踪数据，不要来自形容词。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Nicknames don't count in the medical. A 'tank' needs sprint counts; a 'perpetual motion machine' needs high-intensity share. Numbers from tracking data, not adjectives.

pages.headline: 体能神话是怎么炼成的
pages.headlineEn: How a Stamina Myth Is Made
pages.deck: 从保温杯到坦克：我们对“能跑”这个词做了一次全面体检。
pages.deckEn: From thermos flasks to tanks: we gave the phrase 'can run' a full medical.
pages.bodyLeft: 本刊档案柜里，体能神话分三个等级。入门级的代表是老将维克和他的保温杯——当年所有人笑他杯里泡枸杞，后来他笑到了全勤奖的领奖台上。中级神话靠数据说话：跑动距离、冲刺次数、高强度跑占比，三样齐全才算数。高级神话靠证人：“他一启动我们全让路”，听着唬人，但本刊提醒，让路也可能是礼让。体能是足球里最不容易造假的指标，因为它每场都在被当场复测。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Three tiers of stamina myth: old Vic's thermos — mocked goji berries, then the attendance award; data — distance, sprints, high-intensity share; witnesses — 'when he goes, we move aside', sometimes politeness. Stamina is hardest to fake: retested live every match.
pages.bodyRight: 工业联本周的求助信把体能推成了硬通货：七名伤员躺在医务室，老板只问“他容易受伤吗”。这是本赛季最诚实的一封来信——能力可以慢慢磨，出勤率从签约第一天就开始计息。所以别笑带马拉松成绩单来应聘的人，也别急着为“坦克”掏空钱包。把追踪数据、伤病史、出场连续性摆上桌，神话立刻现出原形：有的是真的，有的只是形容词比较努力。
pages.bodyRightEn: Rivet United, seven down, ask only 'is he injury-prone?' — the season's most honest letter. Availability pays interest from day one. Lay tracking data, injury history and appearance streaks out: some myths are real; others are hard-working adjectives.
pages.pullQuote: 保温杯里的东西不重要，重要的是杯主还在场上。
pages.pullQuoteEn: What's in the thermos doesn't matter. The thermos's owner is still on the pitch.
pages.sidebarBody: 一级：轶事型（保温杯）。二级：数据型（马拉松名次）。三级：绰号型（坦克、永动机）。采购前请确认等级。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Tier one: anecdote (the thermos). Tier two: data (a marathon placing). Tier three: nickname (tank, perpetual motion). Confirm the tier before purchase.

pages.headline: 科斯塔：让路是一种战术
pages.headlineEn: Costa: Stepping Aside Is a Tactic
pages.deck: 边路推土机挂牌，冲击力是真的，说明书也要一起买。
pages.deckEn: The flank bulldozer is listed. The power is real — buy the manual along with it.
pages.bodyLeft: 纵向冲击力在同位置属于稀缺品：边线附近拿球后的第一步爆发，能把整条防线压退五米。体格优势明显，对抗后不掉速、不变形，训练出勤记录干净。“时速200公里”当然是文学修辞，但“对手主动让路”的证词在三个不同来源处得到印证——恐惧本身也是战术资产。
pages.bodyLeftEn: His first step shoves back lines five metres deep; contact costs him neither pace nor shape. '200 km/h' is literature, but 'opponents step aside' is triple-sourced. Fear is a tactical asset.
pages.bodyRight: 冲击型踢法的电费很高：上下翻飞九十分钟，续航能撑多久需要连续样本。技术细节粗糙，传中和最后一传经常跟着惯性一起出界。防守端的位置感靠身体补回来，遇到不跟他拼身体、专打身后空当的对手时会比较狼狈。买坦克，请自备刹车片。
pages.bodyRightEn: The battering-ram style has a heavy electricity bill, the technique is rough, and positioning is patched with muscle. Buy the tank — bring your own brake pads.
pages.pullQuote: 坦克没有倒挡，这是优点，也是报价的一部分。
pages.pullQuoteEn: A tank has no reverse gear. That's a merit — and part of the price.
pages.sidebarBody: 证词三源互证，集锦另存。“时速200公里”系修辞，本刊实测栏目拒绝为形容词出具证明。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Testimony triangulated across three sources; the showreel is filed separately. '200 km/h' is rhetoric — our measurement desk refuses to certify adjectives.

pages.headline: 席尔瓦：加时赛里还在加速的人
pages.headlineEn: Silva: Still Accelerating in Extra Time
pages.deck: 技术普通，续航离谱。有些球队缺的恰恰是这种球员。
pages.deckEn: Ordinary technique, absurd engine. Some sides are missing exactly that.
pages.bodyLeft: 跑动能力是简历里唯一加粗的部分，也确实经得起加粗：比赛末段的高速冲刺不见衰减，加时赛还能完成纵深插上。训练中的耐力口碑从青训一路带到成年队，小学体育老师“他从小参加长跑”的证词与现有表现互相印证。对以体能换机会的球队，他是即插即用的消耗品——褒义的那种。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Running is the CV's only bolded line, and earns it: late sprints don't decay, and in extra time he still runs in behind. The reputation is lifelong. Plug-and-play for effort teams.
pages.bodyRight: 跑动之外的部分都偏薄：射术平平，背身与做球能力一般，机会转化经常对不起自己跑出来的距离。“永动机”型前锋的使用说明很苛刻——球队必须先能造出值得他跑的局面。若指望他解决进球问题，那是让发动机去干方向盘的活。
pages.bodyRightEn: Beyond the running, all is thin. The manual is strict: the team must first build things worth running into — asking him to score hands the wheel to the engine.
pages.pullQuote: 他能跑九十分钟，问题是你让他跑向哪儿。
pages.pullQuoteEn: He can run ninety minutes. The question is where you're pointing him.
pages.sidebarBody: 工业联本周问“他容易受伤吗”，这类球员就是最好的广告。需求与供给罕见对齐，价格仍建议慢慢谈。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Rivet United asked this week: 'Is he injury-prone?' Players like him are the advert. Demand and supply rarely align so well — still, haggle slowly.

mag.season.10.issueTitleEn: Goalkeeper Special: From Hands to Feet

pages.headline: 现在的门将，先考脚法
pages.headlineEn: These Days, Keepers Sit the Footwork Exam First
pages.deck: 一位脚下能组织进攻的门将，和一位三年没踢正式比赛的巨星，同时出现在市场上。
pages.deckEn: A keeper who builds attacks with his feet, and a superstar three years without a competitive match — both on the market.
pages.bodyLeft: 门将的招聘启事变了。一支橙色球队的光头教练把话挑明：他要的不是门线上的雕像，而是后场的第一个组织者。用脚踢球，从加分项变成了入场券。
pages.bodyLeftEn: A bald coach in orange: not a statue on the line but the first playmaker at the back. Feet are the entry ticket.
pages.bodyRight: 同一份周报里，我们还读到一封伤感的简历。曾经用左脚创造无数奇迹的中场，离开赛场三年，想回来。技术录像还在，问题在身体。
pages.bodyRightEn: A sadder CV: a left-footed miracle man, three years out, wants back. Tape intact; the body is the question.
pages.pullQuote: 门将的新考纲里，扑救只是其中一门。
pages.pullQuoteEn: In the keeper's new syllabus, shot-stopping is just one subject.
pages.sidebarBody: 旧考纲：反应、站位、摘高球。新考纲：以上全部，外加一脚四十米斜长传。备考材料请自备。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Old syllabus: reactions, positioning, high balls. New syllabus: all that, plus a forty-metre diagonal. Bring your own revision notes.

pages.headline: 从门线到中线：一次静悄悄的革命
pages.headlineEn: From Goal Line to Halfway Line: A Quiet Revolution
pages.deck: 当教练开始用传球次数考核门将，转会市场的排序也变了。
pages.deckEn: Once coaches began grading keepers on pass counts, the market's order changed.
pages.bodyLeft: 门将是足球里最后一个被重新定义的位置。十年前的评价标准是一张清单：反应、站位、高空球。如今清单多了一行，而且被不少教练挪到第一行：出球。光头教练们的逻辑很直接——如果门将是全队唯一永远面对进攻方向的人，那他理应参与组织。于是市场上出现了新品种：扑救合格、脚法出色的“组织型门将”。本刊提醒买家：先想清楚自己的战术需不需要这双脚，再决定为这双脚付多少钱。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Keeper was the last position redefined: the old checklist (reactions, positioning, high balls) now starts with distribution. The bald logic — the one man facing the play should run it — spawned the 'playmaking keeper'. Decide if your system needs those feet before pricing them.
pages.bodyRight: 另一位本周进入视线的老将提醒我们位置的另一面：天赋从不折旧，身体会。那位曾经的世界级中场，训练录像里的左脚依然能把球传到任何坐标，但三年没有正式比赛的空白，不是集锦能填满的。门将靠脚法延长职业寿命，巨星要靠体检报告争取最后一次机会。两种回归，一个共同结论：先看最近，再看曾经。本刊对两者都保持敬意，也都保持核对。
pages.bodyRightEn: Talent never depreciates; bodies do. His left foot still hits any coordinate on tape, but showreels can't fill a three-year blank. Keepers extend careers with their feet; stars earn one last chance via the medical. We salute both, and audit both.
pages.pullQuote: 情怀负责到场，体检报告负责上场。
pages.pullQuoteEn: Sentiment gets you to the ground. The medical gets you on the pitch.
pages.sidebarBody: 橙色球队：寻组织型门将。东亚方向：寻“90分钟后还能跑”的前锋。招聘启事越来越像体测通知。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: The orange club: seeking a playmaking keeper. The Far East: seeking a striker 'still running after 90 minutes'. Adverts increasingly read like fitness notices.

pages.headline: 奥纳库：脚下有球，心中有图
pages.headlineEn: Onaku: The Ball at His Feet, the Map in His Head
pages.deck: 被改造成门将的前场球员，出球是天赋，扑救是手艺。
pages.deckEn: An outfielder rebuilt as a keeper: the passing is a gift, the saving a craft.
pages.bodyLeft: 出球能力是真材实料：压力下第一脚触球从容，长短传都有谱，后场组织时的选位思路明显带着前场球员的视角——他本就是因反应快被改造成门将的。在之前的体系里，他长期担任后场第一出球点，这不是包装。心态沉稳，丢球后下一脚处理不慌乱，这一点比脚法更难得。
pages.bodyLeftEn: The distribution is real: calm first touch, full range, an attacker's eye — he was converted for his reactions. Years as first outlet. The touch after a mistake never panics; rarer than the feet.
pages.bodyRight: 转型的另一面也写得明白：扑救是手艺活，他的手艺只能算及格。门线反应、一对一封堵都不算强项，高球处理的稳定性一般。买他等于同时买下使用说明——球队必须能把防线推到中场，把门将的扑救需求降到最低。战术不对口，优点会闲置。
pages.bodyRightEn: Shot-stopping is a craft; his is merely passable. The manual: hold the line near halfway, minimise his goalkeeping. Wrong system, and the selling points sit idle.
pages.pullQuote: 他的脚解决了你的出球，谁来解决你的扑救？
pages.pullQuoteEn: His feet fix your build-up. Who fixes your shot-stopping?
pages.sidebarBody: 先答三问再买：你的中卫能顶到中线吗？你的教练接受门将传球失误吗？你的替补门将是什么类型？
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Three questions before buying: can your centre-backs hold halfway? Does your coach forgive keeper errors? And what sort is your backup?

pages.headline: 里瓦斯：左脚还在，日程表空了三年
pages.headlineEn: Rivas: The Left Foot Survives; the Calendar Is Three Years Empty
pages.deck: 技术录像让人想鼓掌，出勤记录让人想开会。
pages.deckEn: The skills tape makes you applaud. The attendance record makes you call a meeting.
pages.bodyLeft: 先说好消息：最新训练录像确认，左脚的传球、远射、任意球功夫都在，视野和节奏感是本能，不会过期。职业素养口碑极佳，豪门履历与国家队大赛经历意味着他不怵任何场面。若恢复到可用状态，这笔签约的竞技上限是本期市场最高的，没有之一。
pages.bodyLeftEn: The latest tape confirms the left foot intact; vision and tempo don't expire. Professionalism beyond reproach. At usable fitness, this is the market's highest ceiling — by far.
pages.bodyRight: 然后是那份体检报告前的问题清单：三年几乎无正式比赛，比赛体能要从零重建；大伤之后的反复风险无法预估；恢复期的耐心与薪水同样昂贵。他最合适的角色可能不是主力，而是特定时段的胜负手。报价请按“能用的分钟数”计算，而不是按“曾经的高度”。
pages.bodyRightEn: Three years without competitive football: fitness from zero, recurrence risk unpriceable, rehab patience costly. Best role: closer, not starter. Price by minutes, not memories.
pages.pullQuote: 别为记忆付顶薪，为分钟付工资。
pages.pullQuoteEn: Don't pay top wages for memories. Pay by the minute.
pages.sidebarBody: 技术：已核，属实。身体：待核，关键项。心态：自述“还想踢”，建议在合同里量化这个“想”。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Technique: verified, real. Body: pending — the key item. Mind: self-reported as 'still wants to play'. Quantify 'wants' in the contract.

mag.season.11.issueTitleEn: From the Favela to the Armband

pages.headline: 两种起点，一份简历
pages.headlineEn: Two Starting Points, One CV
pages.deck: 圣保罗街头的十五岁天才，和葡萄牙低级别联赛的八队老队长，本周同时待价而沽。
pages.deckEn: A fifteen-year-old off São Paulo's streets, and an eight-club veteran captain of Portugal's lower leagues — both awaiting bids.
pages.bodyLeft: 卢卡斯的简历从贫民区的水泥地写起：街头足球出身，15岁被球探带走，青年队比赛里连过三人完成绝杀。南美足球的下一个名字，正在按传统流程排队出道。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Lucas's CV begins on favela concrete: scouted at 15, a winner past three men. The next name queues for launch.
pages.bodyRight: 何塞的简历薄得多，也厚得多：第三、第四级别，八支球队，队长袖标戴了十几年。他本周找的是最后一份工作。山谷镇正在冲击职业联赛，他们需要见过山顶的人。
pages.bodyRightEn: José's CV: eight clubs in tiers three and four, an armband for a decade. Valley Town need a man who's seen the summit.
pages.pullQuote: 一个还没被用旧，一个已经被用透，都是资产。
pages.pullQuoteEn: One isn't worn in yet. One is worn through. Both are assets.
pages.sidebarBody: 山谷镇：要有顶级联赛经验的人带路。附件科技：要一个“射门时不闭眼”的门将。门槛的世界千差万别。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Valley Town: a top-flight veteran to lead the way. Attachment Tech: a keeper 'who doesn't close his eyes at shots'. Thresholds come in all shapes.

pages.headline: 第一份工作与最后一份工作
pages.headlineEn: The First Job and the Last Job
pages.deck: 我们同时读了两份简历，发现它们互为答案。
pages.deckEn: We read two CVs side by side — and found each answers the other.
pages.bodyLeft: 年轻天才的简历永远闪闪发光，因为没来得及留下划痕。卢卡斯的故事符合所有经典元素：贫民区、街头、15岁、球探、连过三人的绝杀。证据链也比一般的神话结实——有公开比赛画面，有青训体系的接收记录。本刊只提醒一件事：青年比赛的样本要打折看，折扣率取决于对手年龄和联赛强度。这不是泼冷水，这是汇率。贫民区走出的少年值得所有祝福，但祝福不计入报价。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Lucas hits every classic beat — favela, streets, 15, the scout, the winner past three. The evidence holds: public footage, documented intake. Discount youth samples by opponent age and league strength. Not cold water — exchange rate. Blessings don't count in the bid.
pages.bodyRight: 老队长的简历刚好相反：没有高光，全是日历。八支球队，十几年，第三第四级别，每个赛季都在。何塞的价值不在任何一次铲抢里，而在“丢球后有人说话”这件事本身。本周山谷镇的来信写得很诚恳：小镇需要一支职业球队，需要一个见过山顶的人带路。年轻球员负责上限，老队长负责下限。签前者赌未来，签后者买现在。预算允许的话，各来一个。
pages.bodyRightEn: The old captain's CV is all calendar, no highlights. His value isn't in any tackle — it's that someone speaks after a goal goes in. Young players set the ceiling; old captains the floor. Sign one for the future, one for now. Budget permitting: both.
pages.pullQuote: 上限让球迷买票，下限让教练睡觉。
pages.pullQuoteEn: Ceilings sell tickets. Floors let managers sleep.
pages.sidebarBody: 青年队高光：按对手年龄折算。低级别全勤：按联赛强度折算。领导力：暂无公式，按嗓门实测。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Youth highlights: convert by opponent age. Lower-league ever-presents: convert by league strength. Leadership: no formula — measure by decibel.

pages.headline: 卢卡斯：水泥地上练出的触球
pages.headlineEn: Lucas: A First Touch Learned on Concrete
pages.deck: 近年来南美最受关注的年轻人之一，这次传闻对得上画面。
pages.deckEn: One of South America's most-watched youngsters. This time the rumour matches the footage.
pages.bodyLeft: 小空间技术是最大资产：街头足球练出的脚下频率和变向，在密集防守里依然能用。那场“连过三人绝杀”的青年队比赛有完整画面，不是口耳相传。15岁进入职业青训，路径清晰，资料连贯——在天才营销遍地的年代，这份透明度本身就值钱。性格外向，适应门槛低。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Street-honed foot speed works in packed defences; the three-man winner is on tape, not hearsay. Pro academy at 15, clean paperwork — transparency itself is worth money. Outgoing; settles fast.
pages.bodyRight: 所有疑问都来自同一个地方：他还没在成人比赛里被验证过。青年队的身体对抗与职业联赛是两个星球，他的体格目前偏单薄。防守端的投入度未知，位置纪律还在培养期。这是一张“未来兑现型”合同，签字前请先回答：你的球队等得起几年？
pages.bodyRightEn: Every doubt has one source: unproven against adults. Youth contact and the pro game are different planets. A futures contract — how many years can you wait?
pages.pullQuote: 天赋是真的，日历也是真的。
pages.pullQuoteEn: The talent is real. So is the calendar.
pages.sidebarBody: 公开画面：青年队比赛，可靠性较高。缺失项：成年联赛样本，零场。报价请按期货逻辑，不按现货。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Public footage: youth matches, fairly reliable. Missing: senior minutes — zero. Price as a future, not as stock.

pages.headline: 老队长费雷拉：八支球队，一副嗓门
pages.headlineEn: Old Captain Ferreira: Eight Clubs, One Voice
pages.deck: 没踢过顶级联赛，却一直在当队长——这本身就是一种位置。
pages.deckEn: Never played top-flight football, always the captain — that is a position in itself.
pages.bodyLeft: 领导力是可观察的：防线站位靠他喊话维持，丢球后的第一反应是组织而不是抱怨。葡萄牙第三、第四级别辗转八队，每到一处都戴上袖标，说明更衣室投票常年有效。经验覆盖保级、升级、杯赛爆冷等各种剧本。对年轻球队，他相当于半个助理教练，还占一个出场名额。
pages.bodyLeftEn: The leadership is observable: the line holds on his voice; after conceding he organises, never complains. Eight clubs, the armband everywhere — half an assistant coach who fills a squad place.
pages.bodyRight: 身体部分请直接读年龄：速度已经下降，回追覆盖面有限，连续一周双赛会很吃力。他的比赛价值随赛程密度递减，随比分焦灼度递增。别指望他拯救运动能力，他能拯救的是秩序。合同建议一年一签，出场安排建议精挑对手。
pages.bodyRightEn: Read the birthdate: the pace is gone and two games a week will hurt. He saves order, not athleticism. One-year deals; pick his opponents carefully.
pages.pullQuote: 他跑不动的距离，用喊话补上。
pages.pullQuoteEn: The yards he can no longer run, he covers with his voice.
pages.sidebarBody: 适用：领先后的最后二十分钟、更衣室、客场雨战。不适用：对攻、冲刺反击、任何需要回追三十米的时刻。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Suitable: the last twenty minutes of a lead, the dressing room, wet away nights. Unsuitable: end-to-end games, counters, any thirty-metre chase.

pages.headline: 幽灵与闪电，价格怎么标
pages.headlineEn: The Ghost and the Lightning: Name Your Price
pages.deck: 一个没速度但总出现在落点上的射手，一个能赢比赛也能消失的边锋。
pages.deckEn: A striker with no pace who's always where the ball lands; a winger who can win a match or vanish from one.
pages.bodyLeft: 卡洛斯·奥尔特加在西班牙第四级别踢了七年，拿过金靴，速度约等于无。但禁区里的嗅觉，让后卫怀疑自己看球的方式。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Ortega: seven years in tier four, a Golden Boot, no pace; defenders doubt their eyes.
pages.bodyRight: 路易斯·埃雷拉辗转九队，快得像发型上那道闪电，状态曲线像过山车。前队友的评价一字不改：“他能一个人赢下比赛，也能整场摸不到球。”
pages.bodyRightEn: Herrera: nine clubs, lightning in his hair. A teammate: 'He can win you the game alone — or go the whole match without a touch.'
pages.pullQuote: 状态起伏不是缺陷，是需要重新定价的资产。
pages.pullQuoteEn: Inconsistency isn't a defect. It's an asset awaiting a reprice.
pages.sidebarBody: 幽灵型：按进球数报价，还是按出场数？闪电型：按最好那场报价，还是按平均那场？本期正文有解。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Ghost type: price by goals or by appearances? Lightning type: by the best game or the average one? Answers inside.

pages.headline: 波动不是风险，糊涂才是
pages.headlineEn: Volatility Isn't the Risk. Confusion Is.
pages.deck: 给“不稳定”标价之前，先搞清楚它不稳定的原因。
pages.deckEn: Before pricing 'inconsistent', learn what makes it inconsistent.
pages.bodyLeft: 转会市场对“状态起伏”向来态度粗暴：直接打折。但本刊的十九张表——对，就是米洛那十九张表——早就说明一件事：波动也分品种。第一种是环境型波动，换个体系就稳定，比如那些“在A队隐身、在B队封神”的人。第二种是随机型波动，连他自己都预测不了，比如闪电型边锋。第三种是伪波动：出场被切得粉碎，分钟数碎成渣，谁来了都得“状态不稳”。三种波动，三种价格，混在一起谈就是送钱。
pages.bodyLeftEn: The market prices form swings crudely. Milo's nineteen spreadsheets show volatility has breeds: environmental — a new system fixes it ('ghost at A, god at B'); random — unpredictable even to him; fake — minutes chopped to confetti. Three breeds, three prices; mix them and you're donating money.
pages.bodyRight: 禁区幽灵是另一道定价难题：他的产出高度集中——不抢断、不组织、不回防，只做一件事，出现在球即将出现的地方。这类球员的正确估值方式是按“每90分钟预期贡献”，而不是按“全场存在感”。存在感低得可怕，产出高得稳定。本周雾港要“丢球后有人说话”的后卫，群岛要“一个人顶三个人”的万能工——需求写得越具体，估值越不容易被故事带跑。
pages.bodyRightEn: The Ghost in the Box does one thing: being where the ball will be. Value him per 90, not by presence — scarily low, eerily stable. Fogharbour want a defender who 'speaks after conceding'; the Archipelago, 'one man doing the job of three'. Specific demands resist stories.
pages.pullQuote: 把波动拆开看，有的是风险，有的是折扣。
pages.pullQuoteEn: Split volatility open: some of it is risk, some of it is a discount.
pages.sidebarBody: 环境型：换队可解，放心买。随机型：无法预测，按均价买。伪波动：样本被切碎，其实是赚了。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Environmental: a new club fixes it — buy. Random: unpredictable — pay the average. Fake: a chopped-up sample — actually a bargain.

pages.headline: 奥尔特加：你在找他，他在落点上
pages.headlineEn: Ortega: You're Looking for Him. He's Where It Lands.
pages.deck: 第四级别七年两夺金靴，速度没有，嗅觉满格。
pages.deckEn: Seven years and two Golden Boots in tier four. No pace. Full scent.
pages.bodyLeft: 禁区内的预判是他的全部，也是他的护城河：传中还在空中，他已经开始向落点移动。两脚都能终结，小动作摆脱很实用。金靴是公开记录、可核的硬产出。七年同一级别，稳定本身就是信息：教练年年换人，他的首发年年不换。价格预计不贵，性价比曲线漂亮。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Box anticipation is his game and his moat: the cross is airborne, he's already moving. The Golden Boot is public record; managers change, his place doesn't. Modest price, lovely value.
pages.bodyRight: 幽灵的另一面必须说清：没有速度意味着没有纵深，防线前提时他的威胁减半。不参与逼抢，防守约等于十打十一。对更高强度联赛的适应性完全没有样本。他是体系的奢侈品——球队必须先能把球稳定送进禁区，他才存在。买他之前，先数清楚自己队里有几个能传中的。
pages.bodyRightEn: No pace, no depth; a high line halves his threat. He doesn't press — you're defending with ten. He's a system luxury: feed the box or he doesn't exist. Count your crossers first.
pages.pullQuote: 他不追球，他去未来等球。
pages.pullQuoteEn: He doesn't chase the ball. He waits for it in the future.
pages.sidebarBody: 金靴：已核。所在级别：第四级。更高级别样本：无。结论：产出真实，成色请按联赛级别折算。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Golden Boot: verified. Level: tier four. Samples above: none. Verdict: the output is real — convert by league strength.

pages.headline: 埃雷拉：闪电为什么换了九朵云
pages.headlineEn: Herrera: Why Lightning Has Changed Clouds Nine Times
pages.deck: 速度顶级，状态玄学，九支球队各有各的版本。
pages.deckEn: Elite speed, mystical form, nine clubs with nine versions of events.
pages.bodyLeft: 纯速度是他的硬通货：启动那一下在任何级别都够用，反击场景里他一个人就是纵深。状态在线时的他是集锦制造机，“一个人赢下比赛”的场次确实存在，且有画面。九支球队的经历换个角度看也是信息——每支球队都愿意赌他一次，说明天赋的可见度极高。
pages.bodyLeftEn: The first burst works at any level; on the counter he is the depth. The 'won the game alone' matches are on tape. Nine clubs thought him worth the gamble — the talent is that visible.
pages.bodyRight: 但九支球队也都没有留住他，这是简历上最大的一句潜台词。状态起伏的原因从未被说清：是伤病管理、战术适配还是职业习惯？三种答案对应三种风险等级。体能储备一般，情绪随比赛走势波动明显。他只适合作为“变招”而非“基石”签约，合同里请写满与出场挂钩的条款。
pages.bodyRightEn: Nine clubs all let him go — the CV's loudest subtext. The cause is unknown: injuries, fit, habits? Three answers, three risk grades. Sign a wildcard, never a cornerstone; write in appearance clauses.
pages.pullQuote: 签闪电的正确姿势：按灯泡的寿命谈价。
pages.pullQuoteEn: The right way to sign lightning: negotiate by a lightbulb's lifespan.
pages.sidebarBody: 九队履历：已核。离队原因：九个版本，互不重合。建议面谈时直接问他：第十支球队想听什么。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Nine-club record: verified. Reasons for leaving: nine versions, no overlap. At interview, ask him directly: what would club number ten like to hear?

mag.season.13.issueTitleEn: Endurance Special: Another Kind of Talent

pages.headline: 马拉松第56名，来踢中场
pages.headlineEn: 56th in the Marathon, Here to Play Midfield
pages.deck: 一个被青训放弃后跑马拉松的中场，一个从工地回到球场的后卫。
pages.deckEn: A midfielder cut by an academy who took up marathons; a defender back from the building site.
pages.bodyLeft: 利亚姆·库珀17岁被职业青训放弃，之后的履历里有一行特别醒目：伦敦马拉松第56名。现在，他想用这双腿重新敲开职业足球的门。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Released at 17, one CV line stands out: 56th in the London Marathon. Now those legs knock again.
pages.bodyRight: 杰克·特纳的故事在另一个工地：多年建筑工人，重返全职足球。队友说他踢球像搬砖——简单、直接、有效。本周两支球队的来信都在找“耐用的人”，巧了。
pages.bodyRightEn: Back from the building site, Turner plays like he lays bricks — simple, direct, effective. Two clubs want 'durable men'. Convenient.
pages.pullQuote: 被放弃过的人，最懂得不下场。
pages.pullQuoteEn: The once-discarded know best how to stay on the pitch.
pages.sidebarBody: 铸铁队：要一个“不介意踢得难看”的后卫。两半联：要一个“90分钟都能被看见”的前锋。两位主角请对号入座。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Cast Iron: a defender 'who doesn't mind playing ugly'. Two Halves United: a forward 'visible for all 90 minutes'. Gentlemen, take your seats.

pages.headline: 第二人生的体能账
pages.headlineEn: The Fitness Ledger of a Second Life
pages.deck: 离开过足球又回来的人，身体账本和别人不一样。
pages.deckEn: Men who left football and returned keep different body accounts.
pages.bodyLeft: 被青训放弃，是足球世界里最普通的事故；从马拉松赛道跑回来，才是新闻。库珀们的优势写在肺里：覆盖面积大，反复冲刺不发怵，九十分钟的供能系统是长距离项目亲手打造的。短板也写在同一份履历里：17岁以后缺了数年系统训练，技术细节停在少年时代。这类球员的评估要拆开两张表：体能表按成年人标准，技术表按回炉青训标准。两表都过，才叫捡到。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Released at 17 — an ordinary accident; running back via the marathon — news. The edge is in the lungs: coverage, repeat sprints, distance-built. The shortfall: training lost after 17, technique frozen in adolescence. Grade fitness as adult, technique as re-enrollee; pass both, then a steal.
pages.bodyRight: 建筑工人特纳提供的是另一种体能逻辑：不是跑出来的，是扛出来的。多年体力劳动给他的核心力量、对抗习惯和对疼痛的钝感，是健身房练不出的品种。队友那句“踢球像搬砖”其实是褒义——防守没有多余花哨，铲球和头球像一道道工序，简单、直接、有效。本刊提醒：“第二人生”球员的伤病史要往入职前翻，工地损耗也是损耗。体检，请翻到第一页。
pages.bodyRightEn: Turner's stamina was carried in, not run in: labour built core strength, contact habits, a numbness to pain no gym sells. 'Plays like laying bricks' is praise — simple, direct, effective. Read the injury file from before football: site wear is still wear.
pages.pullQuote: 一张是跑出来的肺，一张是扛出来的背。
pages.pullQuoteEn: One brings lungs built by running. The other, a back built by carrying.
pages.sidebarBody: 第二人生球员的体检要加两页：足球前的职业史、足球外的运动史。损耗和天赋可能来自同一个地方。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Second-life players need two extra medical pages: pre-football work history, and sport outside football. The wear and the gift may share a source.

pages.headline: 库珀：肺是满的，技术是赊的
pages.headlineEn: Cooper: Full Lungs, Technique on Credit
pages.deck: 马拉松第56名货真价实，问题是足球不是42公里直道。
pages.deckEn: 56th in the London Marathon is real. The problem: football isn't a 42 km straight line.
pages.bodyLeft: 跑动能力有公开纪录背书：伦敦马拉松第56名，不是“据说很能跑”。放到球场上，表现为覆盖面积大、往返不知疲倦、比赛末段强度不降。17岁前的青训底子还在，无球跑动的意识比同龄人成熟。职业态度不用怀疑——被放弃后自己跑回来的人，自律是默认配置。
pages.bodyLeftEn: The engine carries public records: 56th in the London Marathon. On the pitch: huge coverage, undimmed late intensity. A man who ran his own way back after rejection comes with self-discipline.
pages.bodyRight: 技术环节全面偏科：传控精度一般，高压下的第一脚触球容易露怯，进攻三区几乎没有产出。被放弃后的数年空窗意味着战术理解停在半职业水平，需要从头补课。他的定位只能是体系里的“跑件”，指望他组织或终结都是误诊。合同友好，耐心要自带。
pages.bodyRightEn: Technique fails across the board: ordinary passing, a flinching first touch, near-zero output. He's a system's running part; asking him to create or finish is malpractice. Bring patience.
pages.pullQuote: 马拉松不考传控，但职业足球考。
pages.pullQuoteEn: The marathon doesn't test your passing. Professional football does.
pages.sidebarBody: 马拉松名次：公开可查，已核。半职业联赛画面：若干，强度有限。结论：肺是真的，其余按半成品计价。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Marathon placing: public, verified. Semi-pro footage: some, limited intensity. Verdict: the lungs are real; price the rest as unfinished goods.

pages.headline: 特纳：防守像搬砖，是表扬
pages.headlineEn: Turner: Defends Like Laying Bricks. It's Praise.
pages.deck: 从工地直接走回球场的人，铲球和头球都带着工龄。
pages.deckEn: Straight off the building site onto the pitch; the tackles and headers carry years of service.
pages.bodyLeft: 对抗是他的母语：身体强壮，铲球时机老到，头球落点判断准，定位球攻防两端都能用。比赛风格干净直接，没有多余动作。性格踏实，训练出勤率极高，教练布置的任务按工序完成——今天砌墙，明天还砌墙，质量稳定。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Contact is his mother tongue: seasoned tackles, true headers, set pieces both ends. Direct; attendance sky-high. Wall today, wall tomorrow — quality constant.
pages.bodyRight: 转身速度和脚下频率是天然短板，面对灵巧型前锋会被反复调头折磨。出球基本只有安全选项，体系要求他参与组织时会露馅。多年工地生涯留下的劳损，需要队医逐页核对。他的上限肉眼可见，下限也肉眼可见——买他买的是后者，请按需下单。
pages.bodyRightEn: Turning and footwork: natural limits; distribution: a safe setting only. Site work leaves wear — audit the medical. Ceiling visible; so is the floor — the floor is the product.
pages.pullQuote: 他不惊艳任何人，也不背叛任何人。
pages.pullQuoteEn: He dazzles no one. He betrays no one.
pages.sidebarBody: 适合：铸铁队本周“干脏活”岗位。不适合：要求后卫第一脚出球穿透两条线的体系。说明书随人附赠。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Suitable: Cast Iron's 'dirty work' post this week. Unsuitable: systems wanting the centre-back's first pass to break two lines. Manual included.

pages.headline: 安全传球是门手艺
pages.headlineEn: The Safe Pass Is a Craft
pages.deck: 一个白天上班晚上练球、从不冒险的中场，和一个因身高被梯队放弃的门将。
pages.deckEn: A midfielder with a day job who never risks a pass; a keeper cut by his academy for being short.
pages.bodyLeft: 佛朗哥·比安奇的踢球哲学一句话能说完：永远不传给可能丢的那个人。教练的评价耐人寻味：“他不会创造机会，但很少让别人创造机会。”
pages.bodyLeftEn: Bianchi's rule: never pass to a man who might lose it. Coach: 'He won't create a chance — or let others make one.'
pages.bodyRight: 米格尔·纳瓦罗的噩梦写在体检表上：身高不够，梯队再见。但他的出击成功率排在西班牙第三级别第一——老鹰抓高空球，靠的是起跳时机。
pages.bodyRightEn: Cut for height; claiming rate tops Spain's tier three — the Eagle takes high balls on timing, not inches.
pages.pullQuote: 被低估的人的共同点：缺点一眼见底，优点要算。
pages.pullQuoteEn: The underrated share one trait: flaws at a glance; strengths need a calculator.
pages.sidebarBody: 数据之光俱乐部：“只要以前进过很多球，把履历发来就行。”本期没有这样的前锋，只有两种更安静的答案。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Datalight United: 'Just send anyone who used to score a lot.' No such striker in this issue — only two quieter answers.

pages.headline: 无聊的价值，与被拒绝的理由
pages.headlineEn: The Value of Boring, and the Reasons for Rejection
pages.deck: 有些球员的优点不会上集锦，只会出现在教练的睡眠里。
pages.deckEn: Some players' virtues never make the showreel. They appear in the manager's sleep.
pages.bodyLeft: “安全传球”在球迷词典里是骂人的话，在教练词典里是控球率的另一种写法。比安奇式中场的真正价值，要从反向数据里读：他在场时，球队因失误被反击的次数有多少？答案往往漂亮得无聊。这类球员的评估陷阱在于，集锦时代没有人为“没发生的失误”做视频。本刊建议用老办法：看全场，看队友失误时他在哪个位置补。答案会替你报价。
pages.bodyLeftEn: 'Safe passing' insults fans; coaches spell it possession. His value lives in reverse stats — counters conceded from errors when he plays: beautifully boring. Nobody films mistakes that never happened — watch the full match, see where he covers. The answer writes the bid.
pages.bodyRight: 纳瓦罗的“身高问题”则是另一种市场失灵。门将的身高要求有其道理：覆盖面积、高空球、出击范围。但“身高不足所以放弃”是一条懒惰的推理链，正确的问法是：他的起跳时机、落点预判和出击决策，能否对冲那几厘米。第三级别出击成功率第一，至少说明对冲部分成立。被拒绝过的人里常有宝贝，前提是你把“拒绝的理由”重新审一遍，而不是直接继承。
pages.bodyRightEn: Height demands have reasons, but 'too short, release him' is lazy reasoning. Ask instead: do leap timing and drop-zone reading offset the centimetres? Tier three's best claiming rate says partly yes. The rejected hide gems — re-examine the rejection; don't inherit it.
pages.pullQuote: 市场最大的偏见，是把别人的结论当自己的考察。
pages.pullQuoteEn: The market's biggest bias: treating someone else's conclusion as your own scouting.
pages.sidebarBody: 前任放弃他的理由是什么？该理由在你的体系里还成立吗？有没有数据反证？三问之后，再谈价格。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Why did his last club let him go? Does that reason hold in your system? Does data say otherwise? Three questions, then price.

pages.headline: 比安奇：不丢球，是他的全部战术
pages.headlineEn: Bianchi: Not Losing the Ball Is His Whole Tactic
pages.deck: 白天在小企业上班，晚上训练，传球选择保守到极致。
pages.deckEn: Days at a small firm, evenings at training, passing choices conservative to a fault.
pages.bodyLeft: 比赛纪律性极强：位置感好，出球永远选最安全的那条线，失误率低到教练愿意为他改战术板。作为半职业球员，训练出勤和比赛态度无可挑剔，性格温和，是更衣室的稳定因素。对预算有限、先要“别再稀里糊涂丢球”的球队，他是即插即用的止血带。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Extreme discipline: fine positioning, the safest line out, an error rate coaches redraw boards for. For clubs needing to 'stop conceding daft goals' — a plug-and-play tourniquet.
pages.bodyRight: 进攻贡献接近零：不冒险意味着不创造，向前传球的比例低得会让进攻教练失眠。半职业到职业的强度跨越是最大问号，他从未被真正的高压逼抢检验过。白天上班的合同结构也意味着体能储备有限。他是下限型签约——别幻想上限，上限不在他身上，在你的前锋身上。
pages.bodyRightEn: Attacking output: near zero; his forward-pass share gives attack coaches insomnia. Pro intensity is untested; the day job caps stamina. A floor signing — the ceiling lives in your forwards.
pages.pullQuote: 他不创造机会，也不创造灾难。
pages.pullQuoteEn: He doesn't create chances. He doesn't create disasters.
pages.sidebarBody: 教练评语“很少让别人创造机会”未经独立核实，但与比赛画面对得上。证据等级：可信，待强度复测。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: The coach's line — 'rarely lets others create' — is unverified but matches the footage. Grade: credible, pending a re-test at higher intensity.

pages.headline: 纳瓦罗：被身高拒绝，被落点收留
pages.headlineEn: Navarro: Rejected for Height, Adopted by the Drop Zone
pages.deck: 梯队嫌他矮，第三级别的出击榜不嫌。
pages.deckEn: The academy thought him short. Tier three's claiming chart doesn't.
pages.bodyLeft: 反应速度和起跳时机是他的补偿机制：对传中落点的预判极准，出击果断，高空球处理方式成熟——先判断拿不拿得到，再决定出不出去。西班牙第三级别出击成功率第一，公开数据可查。被放弃的经历没有留下怨气，只留下准备活动比别人做得更早的习惯。价格合理，态度免检。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Reactions and leap timing compensate: he reads where crosses drop and judges first whether to go. Best claiming rate in tier three, in public data. Rejection left only earlier warm-ups. Fair price.
pages.bodyRight: 身高带来的限制真实存在：面对高点轰炸型中锋，他需要防线前置保护；远角吊射的覆盖半径吃亏。第三级别到更高级别的传中质量不可同日而语，成功率要打联赛系数。另外样本集中在一支球队、一种打法，体系迁移的适应性待验证。签约前请安排一场“高空球压力测试”。
pages.bodyRightEn: The limits are real: target men need the line pushed up; far-corner lobs stretch him. Apply a league coefficient to the tier-three data. Before signing: a three-day high-ball stress test.
pages.pullQuote: 身高是体检表给的，出击榜是他自己挣的。
pages.pullQuoteEn: The medical form gave him his height. The claiming chart he earned himself.
pages.sidebarBody: 第三级别数据按惯例打折，但“出击成功率第一”打折后仍是第一。建议实测：连续三天，只练传中。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Tier-three data gets the usual haircut — but 'best claiming rate' is still first after the trim. Suggested test: three days, crosses only.

mag.season.15.issueTitle: 四百万粉丝与一双球鞋
mag.season.15.issueTitleEn: Four Million Followers and a Pair of Boots

pages.headline: 四百万粉丝，能换九十分钟吗
pages.headlineEn: Can Four Million Followers Buy Ninety Minutes?
pages.deck: 一位全网知名的网红想圆职业梦，一位业余联赛的好好先生想试试水。
pages.deckEn: An internet celebrity chasing the pro dream; a Sunday-league nice guy testing the water.
pages.bodyLeft: 罗伯特·海耶斯的简历附件是账号后台截图：四百万粉丝。他的视频里球技华丽，评论区一致认为他该踢职业。他本人也这么觉得。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Hayes attaches a screenshot: four million followers. The comments say go pro; he agrees with the comments.
pages.bodyRight: 另一位安德烈·莫雷拉就朴素多了：本地业余队边锋，助攻多，人缘好，自己找上门来问“有没有机会”。而灯塔工厂还在找一个“长传来了先别摔”的中锋——流量和热情，都帮不上这个忙。
pages.bodyRightEn: André Moreira is plainer: amateur winger, assists aplenty, knocking himself. Lighthouse Works want a striker who stays upright under long balls. Traffic can't help.
pages.pullQuote: 流量能兑换发布会，兑换不了出场时间。
pages.pullQuoteEn: Traffic buys a press conference. It doesn't buy minutes.
pages.sidebarBody: 视频可以剪辑，比赛不能。粉丝数是运营数据，不是运动数据。两者都对，但别用前者给后者报价。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Videos can be edited; matches can't. Follower counts are operations data, not sports data. Both real — just don't price the second with the first.

pages.headline: 流量货币化，出场稀缺化
pages.headlineEn: Monetised Traffic, Scarce Minutes
pages.deck: 从“41球”到“四百万粉”：数字越大，越要问出处。
pages.deckEn: From 'the 41 goals' to 'four million followers': the bigger the number, the louder you ask for its source.
pages.bodyLeft: 本刊创刊那年学会的第一课，来自罗里的“41球”：数字本身不会说谎，但数字的口径会。四百万粉丝同理——它是真实的社会资产，能带来球衣销量、赞助谈判和发布会直播的人气，这一点不必酸。问题在于，足球俱乐部同时是每周末接受公开审计的机构：首发十一人里没有“剪辑”这个职位。流量型签约的正确姿势，是把商业合同和竞技合同分开签，分开考核，分开宣布。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Our first lesson was Rory's '41 goals': numbers don't lie; their framing does. Followers are real assets: shirts, sponsors, buzz. But a club is audited every weekend; the XI has no position called 'editor'. Sign, assess, announce the commercial and sporting contracts separately.
pages.bodyRight: 业余神话则是流量的反面：没有数据，只有人缘。“队友都很喜欢他”“助攻很多”——这类评价的可靠性约等于邻居证词，本刊评级：按传闻处理。但注意，传闻不等于错误，只等于未验证。正确的做法是给一次低成本的验证机会：公开试训、跟队两周、踢一场有记录的对抗赛。神话不怕检验，怕的是永远不检验。顺便一提，本刊至今记得卡洛用三明治挡住号码的那个下午——那是对“名气”最诚实的一次处理。
pages.bodyRightEn: The amateur myth has no data, only goodwill — folklore grade. Folklore isn't false, only unverified; so verify cheaply: an open trial, two weeks, a recorded friendly. Myths fear never being tested. We still remember Carlo blocking his number with a sandwich — fame's most honest handling on record.
pages.pullQuote: 当年的41球教会我们：大数字都要配上出处。
pages.pullQuoteEn: The 41 goals taught us: every big number needs a source attached.
pages.sidebarBody: 粉丝四百万：真实，与足球无关。助攻很多：待核。队友喜欢：与转会无关，与食堂有关。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Four million followers: real, unrelated to football. 'Loads of assists': unverified. 'Teammates love him': irrelevant to transfers; highly relevant to the canteen.

pages.headline: 海耶斯：镜头里的球王
pages.headlineEn: Hayes: King of the Clip
pages.deck: 视频里的技术是真的，比赛里的证据是零。
pages.deckEn: The skills in the videos are real. The match evidence is zero.
pages.bodyLeft: 公平地说，他的球感不是演的：视频里的颠球、小范围控球有真功夫，明显是从小踢过球的人。镜头感、表达欲、亲和力都是职业级别——如果“职业”指的是发布会的职业。对需要曝光度的俱乐部，他的商业价值清晰可算：粉丝画像、互动数据、带货记录，全部公开可查。
pages.bodyLeftEn: The touch isn't acted; a childhood of football shows. Camera sense and charm are pro grade — if the profession is the press conference. His commercial value is countable and public.
pages.bodyRight: 竞技部分则完全空白：没有成年正式比赛记录，没有体测数据，没有对抗样本。视频是剪辑的艺术，单挑野球和十一人制是两个项目。年龄也不站在“从头培养”这一边。若签他，请把商业条款与竞技条款分开：发布会可以压轴，首发需要考核。顺序千万别反，反了就是事故。
pages.bodyRightEn: The sporting page is blank: no senior record, no data, no contact samples; street one-v-one isn't eleven-a-side. He may headline the unveiling — but the XI requires exams. Never reverse the order.
pages.pullQuote: 他能卖出门票，问题是谁来赢下比赛。
pages.pullQuoteEn: He can sell the tickets. The question is who wins the match.
pages.sidebarBody: 账号数据：平台可查，已核。比赛样本：无。证据等级：未验证。建议流程：先公开试训，再开发布会。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Account metrics: platform-checkable, verified. Match sample: none. Grade: unverified. Sequence: open trial first, press conference after.

pages.headline: 莫雷拉：业余联赛的好好先生
pages.headlineEn: Moreira: The Sunday-League Nice Guy
pages.deck: 助攻多、人缘好、防守粗糙——业余市场的标准画像。
pages.deckEn: Assists galore, beloved by all, rough at the back — the standard amateur-market portrait.
pages.bodyLeft: 优点是肉眼可见的那种：边路传中质量在业余层面出挑，定位球脚法有内容，前场配合意识好，“助攻很多”的口碑与有限的画面材料能对上。性格是更衣室资产，自己找上门来谈，动机纯粹，要价朴素。对预算紧张、需要进攻套路补充的球队，试错成本极低。
pages.bodyLeftEn: The strengths are visible: crossing that stands out at amateur level, real set pieces — the reputation matches the tape. Motive pure, price humble. Trial cost: rock-bottom.
pages.bodyRight: 短板同样肉眼可见：防守端的选位和对抗都粗糙，身后的走廊常年开放。业余到职业的距离，比他的传中弧线大得多——体能、节奏、身体，每一项都要重新考试。“队友都喜欢他”是温暖的评价，但职业足球的考题写在别处。建议流程：先试训，先短约，先做具体的梦。
pages.bodyRightEn: The weaknesses are as clear: raw defending, the corridor behind open year-round. Amateur-to-pro exceeds his crossing arc. 'Everyone loves him' is warm; the exams are elsewhere. Trial first, short deal.
pages.pullQuote: 人缘帮你进更衣室，防守让你留在名单里。
pages.pullQuoteEn: Charm gets you into the dressing room. Defending keeps you in the squad.
pages.sidebarBody: 签约成本：低。验证成本：两场公开试训。潜在收益：一位会传中的轮换。潜在风险：一条开放的边路走廊。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Signing cost: low. Verification cost: two open trials. Upside: a rotation option who can cross. Risk: one permanently open flank.

mag.season.16.issueTitle: 五人制魔法，十一人制考卷

pages.headline: 小场魔法师，敢来大场吗
pages.headlineEn: Small-Court Sorcerer, Dare You Try the Big Pitch?
pages.deck: 五人制赛场最灵巧的脚，和西3最稳定的低成本射手，本周都在货架上。
pages.deckEn: The deftest feet in futsal, and Spain tier three's steadiest budget scorer — both on the shelf.
pages.bodyLeft: 迪奥戈·佩雷拉在五人制赛场是另一种生物：重心低、变向快，球像粘在脚上。球探报告里写着本期最美的一句话：“他最危险的时候，是没人知道他准备干什么的时候。”
pages.bodyLeftEn: In futsal Pereira is another species: ball glued to his foot. The file's best line: 'most dangerous when nobody knows what he's about to do.'
pages.bodyRight: 卡洛斯·富恩特斯走的是另一条路：地区联赛一级一级踢上来，过去五个赛季进球全部上双。没有魔法，只有到账记录。预算型买家请注意：这个名字值得抄下来。
pages.bodyRightEn: Fuentes: five straight double-figure seasons up the regional leagues. No magic, only payments received. Budget buyers: copy the name.
pages.pullQuote: 魔法负责过人，账簿负责进球，都要核验。
pages.pullQuoteEn: Magic beats the man; the ledger scores the goals. Audit both.
pages.sidebarBody: 五人制技术：按场地与节奏折算。低级别进球：按联赛强度折算。折算后仍然成立，才叫真本事。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Futsal technique: convert by pitch and tempo. Lower-league goals: convert by league strength. Still standing after conversion — that's real.

pages.headline: 小场到大场，隔着多少米
pages.headlineEn: How Many Metres from Small Court to Big Pitch?
pages.deck: 五人制出品的球员越来越多，转会市场需要一张换算表。
pages.deckEn: Futsal graduates keep arriving. The market needs a conversion table.
pages.bodyLeft: 五人制是技术的高压锅：场地小、节奏快、触球次数多，从那里出来的球员，脚下频率和小空间处理是系统自带的。但换算从来不是免费的：十一人制意味着更长的冲刺距离、更少的触球机会、更高的体能门槛。“技术细腻”在小场是天赋，在大场只是入场券。评估五人制球员，本刊的清单有三行：无球时干什么？被身体碾压时怎么办？七十分钟后还剩什么？三个问题都答得上，魔法才值钱。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Futsal is a pressure cooker: tiny pitch, endless touches. Conversion isn't free: longer sprints, fewer touches. 'Silky technique' is a gift on the court, an entry ticket on the big pitch. Checklist: off the ball? When bullied? After seventy minutes? Three answers, and the magic is worth money.
pages.bodyRight: 低成本射手是另一种换算题：连续五个赛季进球上双，这种稳定性比任何单季爆发都稀有。问题同样来自级别——西3的后卫与更高级别的后卫，防守的提前量完全不同。“稳定”能不能跨级别迁移，历史答案是：一部分能，看类型。靠速度的难迁移，靠预判和射术的迁移率高得多。富恩特斯属于后一类，这是他的好消息。坏消息是：检验迁移率的唯一方法，还是买回去踢。
pages.bodyRightEn: Five straight double-figure seasons are rarer than any one-season blast. Can 'consistent' migrate? Partly, by type: pace travels badly; anticipation and finishing travel well. Fuentes is the latter. The bad news: the only test of the exchange rate is to buy and play him.
pages.pullQuote: 级别之间的汇率，只有上场才结算。
pages.pullQuoteEn: The exchange rate between divisions settles only on the pitch.
pages.sidebarBody: 未来之星俱乐部在找二十岁上下、值得长期培养的中场。本期两位都不在该货架，但换算表通用。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Future Stars FC want a midfielder around twenty, worth long-term development. Neither of this issue's pair is on that shelf — but the table is universal.

pages.headline: 佩雷拉：球在他脚下会隐身
pages.headlineEn: Pereira: The Ball Goes Invisible at His Feet
pages.deck: 五人制赛场的魔术师，十一人制的准考证还没领。
pages.deckEn: A futsal-court magician yet to collect his eleven-a-side exam pass.
pages.bodyLeft: 小空间技术接近天花板：低重心、脚下频率、变向的欺骗性，在五人制的高压锅里炼到纯熟。一对一几乎不可防，球探那句“没人知道他准备干什么”不是修辞，是对位者的普遍体验。比赛气质松弛，越是密集防守越来劲。这类天赋在僵局时刻是稀缺资源。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Tight-space technique nears the ceiling; one-v-one, near-unplayable — 'nobody knows what he's about to do' is the markers' experience. The tighter the defence, the happier he is.
pages.bodyRight: 十一人制的三道考题他全没交卷：长距离往返的体能储备未知，无球阶段的跑位习惯待建，被身体碾压后的应对没有样本。五人制的续航逻辑与大场不同，他能保持强度多久，需要实测。建议的签约结构：先梯队或杯赛试用，把“魔法”翻译成“分钟”，再谈长约。
pages.bodyRightEn: The three eleven-a-side papers are unsat: stamina, off-ball habits, response to bullying. Structure: academy or cup audition first; translate 'magic' into 'minutes'; then talk long-term.
pages.pullQuote: 魔法是真的，施法范围待测。
pages.pullQuoteEn: The magic is real. Its area of effect is untested.
pages.sidebarBody: 第一周：体能基线。第二周：对抗赛。第三周：连续两场。三项达标再进大名单，顺序别乱。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Week one: fitness baseline. Week two: contact matches. Week three: two games back-to-back. Pass all three before the squad list. Keep the order.

pages.headline: 富恩特斯：五个赛季，全部上双
pages.headlineEn: Fuentes: Five Seasons, All in Double Figures
pages.deck: 没有华丽技术的射手，有最华丽的东西：到账记录。
pages.deckEn: A striker without gorgeous technique, but with the most gorgeous thing: a payment record.
pages.bodyLeft: 稳定性是他简历的骨架：西3过去五季，进球全部上双，不靠点球堆砌，不靠单季爆发。射术扎实，双脚和头球都有终结手段，禁区内第一脚触球是为射门服务的。无球时愿意做脏活，压迫执行不含糊。“猎人”的绰号来自跑位习惯：不显山露水，专等后卫眨眼。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Five tier-three seasons in double figures, unpropped by penalties. Sound finishing with both feet and head; does dirty work. 'The Hunter': quiet, waiting for the defender to blink.
pages.bodyRight: 上限问题必须直说：他从未在更高级别证明过自己，单兵爆破能力一般，需要体系持续供弹。年龄已过“培养”窗口，买他是买现在，不是买未来。五季稳定也意味着没有惊喜藏在简历里——所见即所得。对预算型需求，这叫对口；对梦想型买家，这叫劝退。
pages.bodyRightEn: Unproven higher, average explosiveness, needs feeding — you buy the present. Five stable seasons, no surprises: what you see is the product. Budget briefs: a match. Dreamers: a warning.
pages.pullQuote: 他不许诺惊喜，他只重复到账。
pages.pullQuoteEn: He promises no surprises. He just keeps getting paid.
pages.sidebarBody: 五季上双：逐季核对，属实。点球占比：正常区间。对手强度：西3标准。结论：数字干净，折算后可下单。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Five double-figure seasons: verified year by year. Penalty share: normal. Opposition: tier-three standard. Verdict: clean numbers — convert, then order.

mag.season.17.issueTitleEn: An Age of Mystery, a Mountain of Running

pages.headline: 他到底多大？这是个问题
pages.headlineEn: How Old Is He, Exactly? Good Question.
pages.deck: 一位资料栏只写“年龄符合注册要求”的前锋，和一位场均跑18公里的压迫狂。
pages.deckEn: A striker whose file says only 'age meets registration requirements'; a pressing obsessive averaging 18 km a match.
pages.bodyLeft: 阿里·哈桑的履历表干净得可疑：青年联赛半场三球出道，随后资料页只剩一句“年龄符合注册要求”。队友说，他从不谈过去，只说“我踢球的时间比你们知道的更久”。
pages.bodyLeftEn: A debut-half hat-trick, then the line 'age meets registration requirements'. Of the past: 'I've been playing football longer than you know.'
pages.bodyRight: 托马斯·里德的简历则精确到小数点：19岁离开职业足球，23岁回来，如今场均跑动18公里，前场压迫从第一分钟进行到补时。本周热搜队还在找“能上新闻的人”——“幽灵”已经上了。
pages.bodyRightEn: Reed: left at 19, back at 23; 18 km a match, pressing into stoppage time. Trending City want 'someone who makes the news' — the Ghost already has.
pages.pullQuote: 一份简历没有年龄，一份简历全是里程。
pages.pullQuoteEn: One CV has no age. The other is nothing but mileage.
pages.sidebarBody: 年龄之谜：注册文件合规，但合规不等于透明。跑动18公里：追踪数据可查。一个要猜，一个要量。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: The age mystery: registration documents compliant — but compliant isn't transparent. The 18 km: tracking data, checkable. One you guess; one you measure.

pages.headline: 年龄之谜的三种解法
pages.headlineEn: Three Solutions to the Age Mystery
pages.deck: 当一名球员的年龄成为谜题，猜猜看谁在付学费。
pages.deckEn: When a player's age becomes a riddle, guess who pays the tuition.
pages.bodyLeft: 足球史上的年龄谜题大致分三类。第一类是登记事故：出生地在哪，档案就在哪，纸面年龄与骨骼年龄各说各话。第二类是营销策略：年轻五岁，报价翻一番，“幽灵”型前锋的经纪人最懂这个汇率。第三类是自我保护：老将把年龄藏进迷雾，因为市场对三十五岁之后的每一岁都格外残忍。三种谜题对应三种核查：查档案、查早年比赛记录、查体测与骨密度报告。本刊提醒：“从不谈过去”本身不是罪证，但绝对是尽调清单的第一行。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Age riddles come in three types: clerical accident — paper age and bone age disagree; marketing — five years younger doubles the fee; self-defence — veterans hide in fog, the market cruel past thirty-five. Three audits: registry, early records, bone density. 'Never discusses the past' isn't guilt — but it's line one of due diligence.
pages.bodyRight: 与幽灵相对的，是把一切写在脸上的压迫狂。里德们的逻辑是透明的：场均18公里，压迫次数、回追距离，全部可查可量。这类球员的风险不在信息，在结构——高强度压迫是消耗品，19岁离开又23岁回来的人，身体的折旧曲线要单独画。本周热搜队想要“上新闻的人”，本刊反而建议他们看看压迫狂：18公里这个数字，比任何热搜都更接近足球本身。
pages.bodyRightEn: Opposite the ghost: the pressing obsessive — 18 km a match, all measurable. The risk is structural: pressing is a consumable; a body gone at 19 and back at 23 needs its own depreciation curve. Trending City want headlines — 18 km is closer to football than any trending topic.
pages.pullQuote: 谜题留给档案室，跑动留给计步器。
pages.pullQuoteEn: Leave the riddle to the archive room. Leave the running to the pedometer.
pages.sidebarBody: 注册文件：合规，已查。早年记录：缺失。身体报告：需授权。结论：可签，但请为“谜”留一个条款。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Registration: compliant, checked. Early records: missing. Body reports: need authorisation. Verdict: signable — with a clause for the 'mystery'.

pages.headline: 哈桑：幽灵的年龄，猎手的脚
pages.headlineEn: Hassan: The Ghost's Age, the Hunter's Feet
pages.deck: 冷静、狡猾、老练，身体状态却像刚进职业足球的年轻人。
pages.deckEn: Cold, cunning, seasoned — with the body of a kid just entering the pro game.
pages.bodyLeft: 比赛内容老练得可怕：跑位时机、假动作的耐心、终结前的冷静，全是“踢过很多年”的痕迹。青年联赛半场三球的出道战有据可查，门前的本能没有过期。最难得的是身体状态——速度、变向、连续作战能力保持得像二十出头。“年龄符合注册要求”之外，他的体能本身就是一份反证。
pages.bodyLeftEn: The play is frighteningly mature: run timing, patience of dummies, calm before the finish; the debut hat-trick is on record. The body — pace, repeat efforts — looks early-twenties. Fitness itself is the counter-exhibit.
pages.bodyRight: 谜的部分必须写进报告：年龄成谜意味着职业生涯长度无法预估，报价年限缺乏锚点。不谈过去意味着背景核查存在盲区。巅峰期为何长期游离于主流视野之外，没有任何权威解释。证据等级：中等，关键项缺失。签约建议：年限从短，条款从严，把“谜”的定价权握在自己手里。
pages.bodyRightEn: Unknown age, unknown career length — the term has no anchor. Silence about the past leaves blind spots. Evidence: medium, key items missing. Advice: short years, strict clauses — price the mystery on your terms.
pages.pullQuote: 他踢了多久不重要，还能踢多久才重要——而这恰恰不知道。
pages.pullQuoteEn: How long he's played doesn't matter. How long he can still play does — and that's the one thing we don't know.
pages.sidebarBody: 自述：“比你们知道的更久”。佐证：队友转述。档案：合规但空白。评级：中等，合同年限请自行加保险。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Self-report: 'longer than you know'. Corroboration: teammates' hearsay. File: compliant but blank. Grade: medium — insure the contract years yourself.

pages.headline: 里德：18公里，从第一分钟开始
pages.headlineEn: Reed: 18 Kilometres, Starting from Minute One
pages.deck: 放弃过足球又跑回来的人，如今用跑动量重新定义前锋。
pages.deckEn: He quit football and ran his way back — now redefining the forward by the kilometre.
pages.bodyLeft: 前场压迫是他的产品说明书：场均18公里不是修辞，是追踪数据。压迫路线聪明，不是瞎跑——封传球线路、逼后卫用弱脚、把出球赶向边线，一套流程完整执行。19岁离开、23岁归来的经历，反而给了他同龄前锋没有的成熟：位置纪律好，情绪稳定，战术板执行到厘米。
pages.bodyLeftEn: The press is his manual: 18 km a match is tracking data, not rhetoric. Smart routes — cut the lane, force the weak foot, herd it wide. Leaving at 19, back at 23 gave rare maturity: discipline, stable mood.
pages.bodyRight: 消耗的账本同样要读：18公里的背后是恢复成本，连续一周双赛时强度能否维持需要样本。进攻三区自己的终结能力中等，压迫制造的球权转化，依赖队友跟进质量。伤病史要翻到19岁那一页，看当初为何离开。他是体系放大器——体系越强他越值钱，反之亦然。
pages.bodyRightEn: Behind 18 km lies a recovery bill. His finishing is mid-level; his turnovers need teammates. Read the injury file back to 19 — why did he leave? A system amplifier: the stronger the system, the more he's worth.
pages.pullQuote: 他跑的不是距离，是对手的处理时间。
pages.pullQuoteEn: He isn't running distance. He's running down the opponent's time on the ball.
pages.sidebarBody: 18公里：追踪数据，已核。覆盖赛季：最近两季。待查项：密集赛程下的强度曲线。复测窗口：冬歇前。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: 18 km: tracking data, verified. Coverage: the last two seasons. Outstanding: intensity under congestion. Re-test window: before the winter break.

mag.season.18.issueTitleEn: Nine Ever-Present Seasons and Ten Positions

pages.headline: 九年全勤，表都没他准
pages.headlineEn: Nine Ever-Present Seasons — More Reliable Than Your Watch
pages.deck: 一位连续九季出场超30次的中场，和一位从前锋踢到后卫的万能补丁。
pages.deckEn: A midfielder with 30+ appearances in nine consecutive seasons; an all-purpose patch from striker to full-back.
pages.bodyLeft: 路易斯·法里亚的体检报告，医生看了想收藏。连续九个赛季出场超过30次，没有伤病，没有停赛风波，像钟表一样打卡上下班。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Faria's medical is frame-worthy: 30+ appearances nine seasons running — clocking in like a clock.
pages.bodyRight: 马库斯·富恩特斯的简历只有一个位置描述：“都可以”。前队友的证词言简意赅：“哪里缺人他都能补”。对了，他与本赛季早些时候那位“猎人”富恩特斯没有亲属关系，本刊已核实。
pages.bodyRightEn: Marcus Fuentes's position: 'wherever'. A teammate: 'Wherever we're short, he fills in.' No relation to the 'Hunter' Fuentes — we checked.
pages.pullQuote: 可靠是足球里最被低估的天赋。
pages.pullQuoteEn: Reliability is football's most underrated talent.
pages.sidebarBody: 全勤：看出场记录与缺席原因。全能：看每个位置的分钟数，而不是听“都能踢”。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Ever-present: read appearances and reasons for absence. Utility: read minutes per position — don't just hear 'he can play anywhere'.

pages.headline: 可靠性，一种沉默的产能
pages.headlineEn: Reliability: A Silent Form of Output
pages.deck: 市场为天赋付溢价，为可靠性付工资——应该反过来想想。
pages.deckEn: The market pays premiums for talent and wages for reliability. Try thinking in reverse.
pages.bodyLeft: 每年转会窗，头条属于天才，工资单属于可靠者。法里亚式中场不生产集锦，只生产“教练不用想这个位置”的安心感——九个赛季里，他的历任主帅换了一茬又一茬，每个人的首发布置会都从他名字写起。可靠性的经济学很简单：一个位置九年不需要买替补、不需要应急预案、不需要战术B计划，省下的转会费和焦虑折现后是个惊人的数字。本刊建议把“缺席成本”写进每份评估报告。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Headlines belong to the gifted, payrolls to the reliable. A Faria-type produces no showreels — only the peace of never thinking about that position; rotating managers all wrote his name first. Nine years with no backup and no Plan B discount to a startling figure. Write 'cost of absence' into every report.
pages.bodyRight: 万金油球员则是可靠性的另一种形状：他不是每天都可靠，而是到处都可用。“哪里缺人补哪里”听起来像夸奖，评估时却是道难题——每个位置都踢过，意味着每个位置都要单独定价。群岛队此前那句“一个人顶三个人”说得很形象，但请记住：三个位置的出场时间，不能叠加成三个人。万金油的正确用法是填空，不是重建。圣杯学院本周在找“私生活检点、值得培养”的年轻人——两位本期主角超龄了，但职业品质这门课，他们早已毕业。
pages.bodyRightEn: The utility man: not dependable daily, deployable everywhere. 'Fills in anywhere' is praise; in valuation, a puzzle — price each position separately. 'One man does the job of three' is vivid; three positions' minutes can't stack into three men. Fill gaps, don't rebuild. Holy Grail Academy want coachable youngsters — ours are over-age.
pages.pullQuote: 钟表不惊艳，但它从不迟到。
pages.pullQuoteEn: A clock never dazzles. It also never arrives late.
pages.sidebarBody: 缺席成本＝替补溢价＋应急预案＋更衣室焦虑。全能折现＝位置数×单位置均价÷体能上限。请自行代入。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Cost of absence = backup premium + contingency + dressing-room anxiety. Utility discount = positions × per-position rate ÷ fitness ceiling. Insert your own numbers.

pages.headline: 法里亚：连续九年，场场在册
pages.headlineEn: Faria: Nine Straight Years on Every Teamsheet
pages.deck: 不出集锦的中场，出全勤记录。体检报告干净得像出厂设置。
pages.deckEn: A midfielder who produces no showreels, only attendance records. The medical reads like factory settings.
pages.bodyLeft: 可靠性是硬数据：连续九个赛季出场30+，无重大伤病，无纪律停赛，出勤曲线平得像一条直线。踢法服务于稳定：传控安全，位置纪律严明，跑动量常年在线。教练更替不改其位，说明战术兼容性极强。对任何需要“忘掉这个位置”的球队，他就是答案本身。价格也透着靠谱——没有溢价项。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Hard data: 30+ appearances nine seasons running. Safe passing, strict discipline; managers change, his place doesn't. For clubs wanting to 'forget that position', he is the answer; the price has no premium items.
pages.bodyRight: 硬币的另一面：九年的稳定也意味着九年的上限清晰可见。他不提供爆点，节奏偏慢，高强度逼抢下的出球会趋于保守。年龄已站在合同短年化的一边。“从未受伤”是运气与体质的合谋，不是永动保证书，保险条款照买。买他买的是确定性，请别在签约后抱怨确定性的无聊。
pages.bodyRightEn: Nine stable years make the ceiling visible: no spark, conservative under a press. 'Never injured' is luck, not a guarantee — buy the insurance. You buy certainty; don't complain it's boring.
pages.pullQuote: 买他不为惊喜，为不用想。
pages.pullQuoteEn: You don't buy him for surprises. You buy him so you never have to think.
pages.sidebarBody: 九季出场：逐季核对，属实。体检：异常健康，原文如此。缺席历史：近乎空白。结论：可签，年限从短。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Nine seasons of appearances: checked yearly, true. Medical: abnormally healthy — the doctor's words. Absence history: near-blank. Verdict: signable; keep the term short.

pages.headline: 富恩特斯：十个位置，一份工资
pages.headlineEn: Fuentes: Ten Positions, One Pay Packet
pages.deck: “哪里缺人他都能补”——这句话要按位置逐个验收。
pages.deckEn: 'Wherever we're short, he fills in' — a claim to inspect position by position.
pages.bodyLeft: 多功能性是真实的：地区联赛多年，前场到后场的出场记录都能翻到，每个位置都能完成基本任务，战术理解因此高于同水平球员。性格随和，临危受命不怯场，杯赛轮换和伤病潮里他是教练的备胎箱。工资预期温和，对薄预算球队，他一个人就是名单深度的充值卡。
pages.bodyLeftEn: The versatility is real: minutes from front to back. He doesn't blink mid-crisis — in injury storms he's the spare-parts box. Gentle wages; for thin budgets, a one-man top-up card for depth.
pages.bodyRight: 验收时必须拆开看：“都能踢”不等于“都踢好”，他在每个位置的上限都是“够用”，没有一个是“出色”。体能一般，补边后卫这种高消耗位置时续航吃紧。地区联赛的对抗强度与职业赛场的差距，会同时考验他所有的位置。正确用法：特定场次的填空者。错误用法：建队基石。
pages.bodyRightEn: 'Can play anywhere' isn't 'plays well anywhere' — the ceiling is 'adequate', never 'good'. The jump to pro contact tests every position at once. Correct use: gap-filler. Incorrect: cornerstone.
pages.pullQuote: 他能填任何坑，前提是你别把坑挖太大。
pages.pullQuoteEn: He can fill any hole — provided you don't dig it too big.
pages.sidebarBody: 逐位置核对分钟数与对手级别，“都能踢”按最弱一环定价。友情提示：门将位置不在其列，别被热情冲昏头。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Check minutes and opposition per position; price 'can play anywhere' by the weakest link. Reminder: goalkeeper is not among them. Don't let enthusiasm carry you away.

pages.headline: 替补席上的冠军奖牌
pages.headlineEn: A Winner's Medal on the Bench
pages.deck: 一位拿着冠军奖牌却常年坐板凳的门将，和一位黄牌比进球多的边后卫。
pages.deckEn: A keeper with a winner's medal and a permanent seat; a full-back whose yellow cards outnumber his goals.
pages.bodyLeft: 欧文·哈里斯的履历有个反直觉的注脚：杯赛冠军成员，长期替补。他的价值写在别人的表现里——主力门将状态神勇的那些年，训练场的标准是他定的。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Harris's footnote: cup winner, long-term reserve. In the number one's best years, the training standard was his.
pages.bodyRight: 鲁伊·卡多索的统计页则是另一种奇观：连续两个赛季联赛黄牌王。防守侵略性拉满，禁赛记录同样拉满。预算联本周在找“低成本高产射手”——这两位都不是射手，但“高产”这个词，黄牌榜上那位很熟。
pages.bodyRightEn: Cardoso tops the yellow-card chart two seasons running. Budget United want a 'low-cost, high-output striker' — neither man scores, but the card-topper knows 'output'.
pages.pullQuote: 板凳深度不够时，冠军经验会硌得人疼。
pages.pullQuoteEn: When the bench is thin, medal experience digs in where it hurts.
pages.sidebarBody: 预算联本周来信：要低成本高产射手。本期一位守门、一位领牌，均不符合——这正是转会窗的幽默感。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Budget United's letter: one low-cost, high-output striker. This issue offers a keeper and a card collector — neither qualifies. That is the transfer window's sense of humour.

pages.headline: 第二门将的经济学
pages.headlineEn: The Economics of the Second Goalkeeper
pages.deck: 替补门将是足球里最贵的奢侈品，直到他突然变成必需品。
pages.deckEn: A backup keeper is football's priciest luxury — right up until he becomes a necessity.
pages.bodyLeft: 一支球队每年在第二门将身上花的钱，看起来像给空座位买票。直到主力门将受伤那一周，整个赛季突然押在那个坐了一年板凳的人身上——这时候再贵的工资都显得便宜。好的第二门将是稀有品种：水平要接近主力，心态要接受替补，训练要维持标准，出场要即插即用。四条同时满足的人，市场上屈指可数。哈里斯的冠军奖牌和多年替补履历恰好说明：他早就学会了这门反人性的手艺。
pages.bodyLeftEn: A second keeper looks like a ticket for an empty seat — until the number one pulls something and the season lands on a man who's sat a year. Starter quality, bench-accepting temperament, plug-and-play readiness: such men fit on one hand. Harris mastered that unnatural craft long ago.
pages.bodyRight: 黄牌收藏家则是另一种成本核算。侵略性是他的产品，禁赛是产品的运费——连续两个赛季黄牌王，意味着每个赛季都有几场比赛，你的边路要自己想办法。算账的正确方式不是问“他会不会停赛”，而是问“停赛那几场丢多少分，在场那几场抢多少分”。如果后者更大，黄牌就是税而不是病。当然，税率高到影响现金流时，财政再健康的俱乐部也该考虑转型。
pages.bodyRightEn: Aggression is his product; suspensions are the shipping fee. Don't ask 'will he be banned?'; ask whether the banned games cost more points than his aggression wins. If not, cards are a tax, not a disease — until the rate hurts cash flow.
pages.pullQuote: 替补的价值平时看不见，看台看得最清。
pages.pullQuoteEn: A substitute's value is invisible day to day. The stands see it clearest.
pages.sidebarBody: 第二门将价值＝主力缺阵概率×赛季权重。黄牌成本＝停赛场次×对手强度−侵略性收益。滚动核算。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Backup-keeper value = starter-absence probability × season weight. Card cost = banned games × opponent strength − aggression gains. Reconcile monthly.

pages.headline: 哈里斯：板凳上的指挥官
pages.headlineEn: Harris: Commanding from the Bench
pages.deck: 冠军奖牌是真的，替补也是真的，这两件事并不矛盾。
pages.deckEn: The medal is real. So is the bench. The two don't contradict.
pages.bodyLeft: 指挥防线的能力是门将里的第一梯队：嗓门、手势、站位调度，整条后防线在他的口令里移动。冠军赛季虽未打满，更衣室与训练场的贡献有口皆碑。扑救基本功扎实，准备活动职业到刻板。作为“随时能进首发”的第二门将，他的履历几乎是为这个岗位量身写的——哪家球队贴出这类需求，照着他抄就行。
pages.bodyLeftEn: His command of a defence is first tier: voice, gestures, traffic control. He didn't play the full title season, but his training-ground work is on every lip. As a 'ready any time' number two, his CV reads bespoke.
pages.bodyRight: 疑问集中在“节奏”二字：长期替补意味着比赛感觉需要预热，突然进首发的前两场，通常是他最脆弱的时候。年龄增长后，反应的下坡不可避免，只是被经验掩盖得很好。习惯了强队防线的他，若去一支被压着打的球队，指挥体系要重建。合同友好，但请把“出场激励”写细一点。
pages.bodyRightEn: The doubts cluster around 'rhythm': match feel needs preheating; his first two games after promotion are the frailest. Age slows reactions; experience hides the slope. Friendly contract; detail the appearance incentives.
pages.pullQuote: 他指挥了整条防线，除了自己的出场时间。
pages.pullQuoteEn: He commands the entire back line. Just not his own minutes.
pages.sidebarBody: 适合：有主力门将、要竞争与保险的球队。不适合：需要他立刻场场首发的球队。预热两场，然后放心。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Suitable: clubs with a number one, wanting competition and insurance. Unsuitable: clubs needing him to start every week now. Preheat two games, then relax.

pages.headline: 卡多索：侵略性的税率
pages.headlineEn: Cardoso: The Tax Rate on Aggression
pages.deck: 连续两季黄牌王，防守是真的凶，停赛也是真的多。
pages.deckEn: Card-chart topper two seasons running. The defending is genuinely fierce; the bans genuinely frequent.
pages.bodyLeft: 边路防守的存在感拉满：贴身、下脚快、对抗欲望强，对方边锋拿球前要先做一次心理建设。他的侵略性不全是鲁莽——多数犯规发生在战术需要的位置，属于“聪明的脏”。缠斗能力强，比赛气质硬，落后时刻是少数还敢做动作的人。多次被足协禁赛的记录本身，也证明他的动作常年在规则边界办公。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Maximum presence in wide defence: tight, quick, loves contact. The aggression isn't reckless — most fouls happen where tactics require: intelligent dirt. Still attempts things when behind. The bans prove he keeps an office on the edge of the laws.
pages.bodyRight: 成本页同样清晰：黄牌王的赛季意味着固定的停赛缺席，关键场次的停赛风险是战略级问题。纪律记录还可能带来裁判的“重点关注”——同样的动作，别人黄牌他可能升级。位置感的短板靠侵略性掩盖，遇到耐心的对手会被钓鱼。签约前请先看看你的替补边后卫是谁：他每年都要上场的。
pages.bodyRightEn: The cost page: fixed suspensions each season; a ban in a big fixture is strategic. Referees' 'special attention': another player's yellow may be his red. Patient opponents will bait him. Check your reserve full-back: he'll be playing.
pages.pullQuote: 他的犯规都懂战术，停赛也懂——专挑关键场次。
pages.pullQuoteEn: His fouls understand tactics. So do his bans — they pick the biggest games.
pages.sidebarBody: 黄牌纪录：连续两季，已核。禁赛场次：可量化。裁判印象分：不可量化但真实存在。预算请预留替补方案。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Card record: two seasons running, verified. Suspension games: quantifiable. Referee impression: unquantifiable, very real. Budget for a deputy.

pages.headline: 拳击手改行踢中卫
pages.headlineEn: The Boxer Who Switched to Centre-Back
pages.deck: 一位拿过青少年重量级拳王的后卫，和一位过人成功率一成的天才赌徒。
pages.deckEn: A defender with a junior heavyweight title; a genius gambler whose dribbles succeed one time in ten.
pages.bodyLeft: 瑞安·凯利青少年时期双线作战：白天练足球，晚上练拳击，顺手拿了个青少年重量级冠军。如今他把背身作战的习惯带进禁区——对方中锋先撞到的，永远是他的前臂。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Football by day, boxing by night; Kelly collected a junior heavyweight crown. In the box, strikers meet his forearm first.
pages.bodyRight: 里卡多·门德斯的数据会让分析师沉默：十次过人，九次失败。但那一次成功，可能直接赢下比赛。对了，他与第七期那位荷兰飞翼纯属同姓，命运的相似到此为止。
pages.bodyRightEn: Mendes: nine dribbles out of ten fail; the one success can win the match. Only the surname links him to issue seven's Dutch flyer.
pages.pullQuote: 一个从不退，一个从不稳，都是票房。
pages.pullQuoteEn: One never retreats. One never repeats. Both sell tickets.
pages.sidebarBody: 拳台纪律能否换算成禁区纪律？一成成功率为什么还有人排队？本刊再次提醒：先算期望值，再谈魅力。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Can ring discipline convert to box discipline? Why queue for a ten-per-cent success rate? Our standing advice: compute the expected value first, then discuss the charm.

pages.headline: 对抗与期望：两种另类资产
pages.headlineEn: Contact and Expectation: Two Alternative Assets
pages.deck: 拳台来的人和牌桌来的人，都得先过足球的算盘。
pages.deckEn: Whether they arrive from the ring or the card table, football's abacus has the final say.
pages.bodyLeft: 跨界运动员的卖点永远诱人：拳击手的核心力量、抗击打和一对一心理战，听起来就是为禁区肉搏定制的。但拳台纪律和禁区纪律有个致命差别——拳击里搂抱是技术，足球里搂抱是点球。凯利们的转型评估要盯紧“手部习惯”这一项：前臂卡位是艺术，双手上背是灾难。好消息是，拳击出身的人通常不怕挨骂，教练改造起来顺手。对抗可以教，胆量教不了，他两项都自带。
pages.bodyLeftEn: A boxer's strength, punch resistance and one-v-one psychology sound built for the box. Clinching is technique in boxing, a penalty in football: forearm is art, two hands on the back is disaster. Boxing men don't mind being barked at. Contact can be taught; nerve can't.
pages.bodyRight: “赌徒”型前锋则是转会市场的哲学题：十次过人九次失败，按常理该直接拉黑，但那一次成功如果出现在禁区里，期望值突然就翻正了。关键不在成功率，在出手位置——中圈浪过是送球权，禁区前沿的尝试叫造杀机。评估赌徒的正确姿势是画一张“尝试分布图”：点落在哪，他就值多少钱。本周王座俱乐部在找高水平替补门将，与这两位无关——本刊只是提醒：别在转会窗上头，那是赌徒的工作。
pages.bodyRightEn: Nine dribbles out of ten fail; the tenth in the box flips expected value positive. Location, not rate: centre-circle attempts gift possession; edge-of-area ones manufacture danger. Appraise by the map of attempts. Throne City's keeper vacancy? Unrelated. Don't gamble in the window; that's the gambler's job.
pages.pullQuote: 过人失败九次不可怕，可怕的是位置不对。
pages.pullQuoteEn: Nine failed dribbles aren't the problem. Failing them in the wrong place is.
pages.sidebarBody: 拳击冠军：青少年重量级，已核。过人成功率：一成，属实。关键变量：尝试位置分布图，签约前务必索取。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Boxing title: junior heavyweight, verified. Dribble success: one in ten, accurate. Key variable: the map of attempts — request before signing.

pages.headline: 凯利：禁区里的重量级
pages.headlineEn: Kelly: The Heavyweight of the Penalty Box
pages.deck: 背身作战是他的舒适区，对方中锋的难受区。
pages.deckEn: Back-to-play defending is his comfort zone — and the opposing striker's misery.
pages.bodyLeft: 身体对抗是拳台认证的：核心力量、平衡感、贴身缠斗的耐心，都是青少年重量级冠军的底子。背身防守尤其出色——对方中锋接球瞬间，他已经把位置站成了一堵墙。性格沉稳，被挑衅不上头，拳击教会他挨打之后的呼吸。定位球攻防两端都是武器，解围方式朴素但高效。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Ring-certified contact: strength, balance, clinch patience. When a striker receives back-to-goal, Kelly is a wall. Provocation doesn't move him — boxing taught him to breathe after a hit.
pages.bodyRight: 转型遗留问题要列清楚：手部动作的习惯是点球隐患，裁判尺度严的联赛里学费不菲。转身速度与回追能力一般，身后球需要防线整体补偿。出球能力朴素，体系要求中卫组织时他会显得安静。拳击履历还带来一个体检重点：手部与肋部的陈旧伤，请队医逐页核对。
pages.bodyRightEn: The leftovers: hand habits are a penalty risk in strict leagues; ordinary recovery pace — balls in behind need cover; distribution is plain. The boxing past adds a medical focus: hands, ribs.
pages.pullQuote: 他在拳台学会了不怕，在禁区学会了不抱。
pages.pullQuoteEn: The ring taught him not to fear. The box taught him not to hug.
pages.sidebarBody: 重点核对：手部、肋部、鼻梁。拳击旧伤不是减分项，是知情项。冠军证书：青少年重量级，已核。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: Check carefully: hands, ribs, nose. Old boxing injuries aren't deductions — they're disclosures. Title certificate: junior heavyweight, verified.

pages.headline: 门德斯：一成成功率的天才
pages.headlineEn: Mendes: The Genius with a Ten-Per-Cent Success Rate
pages.deck: 街头足球出身，过人如抽牌，十次九输，赢一次就收比赛。
pages.deckEn: Street-football stock. Dribbles drawn like cards — nine losses in ten, one win to settle the match.
pages.bodyLeft: 创造力和胆识是真货：小范围的节奏变化、假动作的想象力，带着街头足球的原生味道。最关键的一点——他的尝试多集中在进攻三区：失败九次不丢大局，成功一次直接改写比分。心理素质异常好，失误后下一回合还敢做动作，这在“赌徒”型球员里是最稀有的品质。僵局与杯赛，是他的营业时间。
pages.bodyLeftEn: Attempts cluster in the final third — nine failures cost little, one success rewrites the scoreline. After an error he tries again next play, the rarest quality in gamblers. Deadlocks and cup ties are his hours.
pages.bodyRight: 风险清单同样坦诚：一成成功率意味着常规时间的产出极不稳定，联赛长跑里这种波动会磨掉教练的耐心。体能和防守投入都在及格线下，体系要为他留特权位。纪律层面的“赌性”是否只留在球场上，背景调查要做足——这句话不是玩笑。合同建议：底薪加进球助攻重奖，让赌徒为自己下注。
pages.bodyRightEn: One-in-ten success means unstable output that grinds a manager down. Whether the gambling stays on the pitch needs a real background check — not a joke. Low base, heavy bonuses: let him bet on himself.
pages.pullQuote: 让他下注可以，筹码必须是他自己的奖金。
pages.pullQuoteEn: Let him place his bets — but make the chips his own bonus money.
pages.sidebarBody: 场上数据：尝试分布图必查。场下背景：“赌性”边界必查。前者定价格，后者定能不能谈。
pages.sidebarBodyEn: On pitch: the map of attempts — mandatory. Off pitch: the boundaries of the 'gambling nature' — mandatory. The first sets the price; the second decides if you talk at all.
